observed_result_for_record: Static (container source at the deployed commit): the forward flow is exactly as claimed — EmailController@view returns the raw Email model; view.blade.php serializes it with @json($email) (:1222) and the forward computed returns action.email.reply (:1373); control.blade.php mounts x-admin::tinymce on textarea#reply; tinymce/index.blade.php runs tinymce.init with only plugins/toolbar/upload options and NO valid_elements/sanitize hook; the same field at automatic sinks IS guarded (v-safe-html at view.blade.php:246, strip_tags at DataGrid.php:472). Runtime (the sole control actually applied, HtmlFilter::process — the same call ingestion makes): the blacklist demonstrably passes dangerous constructs on this runtime — data:text/html URIs survive in both href and action, and SVG <set>/<animate attributeName=...> constructs survive intact (attribute names lowercased, which HTML parsing treats identically). Controls were correctly removed (on* attributes stripped, <script>/<iframe> removed, literal and entity-encoded javascript: URIs and newline-split javascript: rewritten to #), and the <style> element was kept but its content emptied. So the forward editor receives content that a same-origin editor iframe renders with these constructs intact. TinyMCE 6.6.2 editor-iframe execution was not observable in this environment (no browser harness; TinyMCE loaded from cdnjs) — the missing second sanitizer layer and the weak sole filter are runtime-confirmed; actual in-editor execution remains the record's stated library/browser fact.
